TraceBuffer::CreateTraceBufferRingBuffer is declared in the preexisting private header without a definition in this selection. The selected Node Agent instantiates its actual NodeTraceBuffer and does not call that factory. Broader V8 ring-buffer admission would need its original body.

Original clock/Recorder/Abseil source is retained, but Main currently supplies network/native-memory owners only for 64-bit Windows/Linux. The proposed build step is created only when both actual owners exist, so it does not claim Darwin Agent assembly.

Zig/Clang acceptance of original Microsoft extensions, ETW sections/import linkage, Abseil/Node concurrency, observer callbacks and real Recorder behavior are future admission gates; none was executed.
